mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM supplier_payable_settlement_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND active_payment_id=#{paymentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE supplier_settlement_preparation SET state_json=#{stateJson},version=#{version},status=#{status},attempts=#{attempts},updated_at=#{updatedAt},next_attempt_at=#{nextAttemptAt},lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, active_payment_id=#{owner},registered_operation_id=#{registered} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND id=#{id} AND version=#{expectedVersion} AND input_json=#{inputJson} AND status IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM supplier_settlement_preparation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM supplier_settlement_preparation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND active_payment_id=#{paymentId}
SELECT * FROM supplier_settlement_preparation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND payment_id=#{paymentId} ORDER BY created_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT state_json FROM supplier_settlement_preparation_revision WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND preparation_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}

SELECT q.tenant_id,q.id,q.trace_id,business.business_no,submitted.process_instance_id FROM supplier_settlement_preparation q LEFT JOIN supplier_payment_authorization origin ON origin.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND origin.id=q.payment_id LEFT JOIN approval_application business ON business.tenant_id=q.tenant_id AND business.id=origin.application_id LEFT JOIN approval_submission_round submitted ON submitted.tenant_id=business.tenant_id AND submitted.application_id=business.id AND submitted.round_no=origin.round_no WHERE (q.status='QUEUED' AND q.next_attempt_at<=#{nextAttemptAt}) OR (q.status='RUNNING' AND q.lease_until<=#{leaseUntil}) ORDER BY COALESCE(q.next_attempt_at,q.lease_until),q.created_at,q.id LIMIT 10
SELECT command_json FROM supplier_payable_settlement_operation WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND id=#{id} AND preparation_version=#{version}
